<b>Wardenflies</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are large, stout [[Slab_Penitents#The_Jailers|jailers]] who are responsible for capturing sinners and punishing prisoners in [[the Slab]].<ref>Wardenfly Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Heavy, hairy jailer responsible for capturing sinners and punishing prisoners."</i></ref> When encountered outside of the Slab, they hold a metal cage, taking [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to the Slab if she is captured by it.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==

When not wielding a cage, Wardenflies have several attacks:

* <b>Spit</b>: The Wardenfly spits several globs of non-damaging goo at Hornet that require fierce button-mashing to escape if touched. The globs persist on the ground, but disappear after a short while or if hit two to four times.
* <b>Body Slam</b>: The Wardenfly flies to be above Hornet's current location and slams downward onto the ground.
* <b>Two-Step Lunge</b>: The Wardenfly lunges in Hornet's direction, reels for a moment, and lunges again.

Wardenflies always deal {{Damage|2}}.

The Two-Step Lunge attack can easily catch Hornet unawares, as the Wardenfly appears to be idle when between lunges. 

Dashing out from under a Wardenfly's Body Slam is an easy way to avoid any damage. As such, the attack becomes much deadlier when paired with a Spit from another Wardenfly or [[Guardfly]].

If [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] has defeated the [[Bell Beast]] and acquired [[Cling Grip]], Wardenflies spawn in certain rooms in [[Deep Docks]], [[Greymoor]], and [[Bilewater]] wielding a Hornet-sized cage. If Hornet is spotted, they slam the cage down in an attempt to trap her inside, abducting her to [[the Slab]]'s jail and [[Cloakless Crest|confiscating all non-movement items and Tools]] if successful. Once a cage-wielding Wardenfly has been defeated, it does not respawn.

Wardenflies do not spawn with cages if Hornet has not defeated the [[Bell Beast]], has interacted with the [[Fayforn]],<ref group=Source name=code>FSM <code>DJ Get Sequence</code> in <code>Peak_08b</code>.</ref> or has completed the arena that returns her belongings. The Wardenfly in [[Greymoor]] additionally does not spawn unless the <i>[[SEARCH: Silent Halls]]</i> [[Acts|objective]] has been completed, and [[Moorwing]] has been defeated.

If Hornet is [[Witch_Crest#Cursed_Crest_interactions|Cursed]], the capture fails and she is not transported to the Slab. Instead, she wakes up at the same spot, surrounded by vines that have killed the Wardenfly.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Wardenflies have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==

Wardenflies can be found primarily in the Slab's upper areas. In [[Acts]] 1 and 2, they appear in certain parts of [[Deep Docks]], [[Greymoor]], and [[Bilewater]] if [[Cling Grip]] has been acquired and the [[Bell Beast]] has been defeated (and the <i>[[SEARCH: Silent Halls]]</i> [[Acts|objective]] has been completed, in the case of the Greymoor location).

==Trivia==
* A Wardenfly corpse trapped in the mouth of a [[Barnak]] can be found in [[Putrified Ducts]], with the [[Slab Keys|Key of Apostate]] dropped nearby.
* Successfully using [[Cross Stitch]] on their projectile destroys it, but the effect of Cross Stitch is not triggered.
